We have read your complaint carefully and understand how stressful this situation has been for you and Benny. You reported that the pet crate arrangement and handling on your journey were not managed as expected, that you faced uncertainty while trying to resolve the issues, and that your follow-up did not lead to the outcome you needed.

First, we want to acknowledge the core problem: companion animal travel depends on precision, and when a traveler feels unsupported or unclear about next steps, trust is immediately affected. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is committed to treating every case with urgency and care, and we will not dismiss your concerns as routine. Aurelia Skyways takes reports of crate handling, documentation, and communication seriously, because even a minor breakdown can create major risk for a pet and major distress for a guardian.

To move your matter forward, we are initiating a calm, stepwise review across the relevant stations and internal teams. This review will focus on the timeline of the crate custody, the applicable handling notes, and the communications that were sent to you. We will also verify whether the crate details recorded at check-in match what was used during your travel route, since mismatches can cascade into delays in locating or confirming a crate.

For any remaining issues related to a lost crate, <<FACT F118>>. We will ensure that your case is correctly linked to the crate identifier in our system so nothing is lost in the handoff between departments.

If your complaint concerns damage, delayed delivery, or lost accessories within the crate, please understand that we can still document those elements and coordinate with the appropriate department for a resolution. When you have additional context, such as the condition observed upon retrieval, any photos you can share, and the names of the staff you interacted with, it helps us validate findings faster and reduces repeat requests.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and we will work quickly and transparently to address your situation. Companion Animal Travel Desk
